'''Dr. Mell''' (known as Doc Mell) was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] practicing medicine on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Mell treated many of the patrons of [[Dannar's Claim]], including [[Bohmer]] and [[Zedd Grobbo|Zedd]]. Mell wore a special cowl that maintained the moisture his skin needed as an aquatic species.<ref name="Kenobi" />
